audit.whatIsWrong: Level 3 was credited to Yasuo while whys[2] on the same page calls it a skill lane, and 2+ items was credited to Yasuo while whys[6] says your AP scaling and Hemoplague teamfighting outclass him.
audit.why: Packet levelChart: Vladimir, Skill, Skill, Yasuo, Vladimir, Yasuo, Vladimir — matching the prose.
audit.corrected: Row 2 to Skill (5/10), row 6 to Vladimir (7/10), as matched full/content pairs.

audit.why: Spikes already sit on the real timings: his Sweeping Blade window at 3-5, your Hemoplague at 6, his crit item, your two-item teamfight scaling.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[2] told the reader Yasuo can 'Windwall your Transfusion and E-cast poke'. Wind Wall blocks projectiles, and no Vladimir ability is a projectile — Transfusion is a targeted spell and Tides of Blood detonates around him. spikes[3].text also spoke of 'kiting his windwall with pool', which describes nothing. The do's and don'ts carried no cooldowns.
audit.why: Kit file: Yasuo W Wind Wall 'blocks all enemy projectiles for 4 seconds', 25/23/21/19/17s; Q Steel Tempest 4s, knocks up at 2 stacks; E Sweeping Blade 475 range, near-zero cooldown, rides minions; R Last Breath 70/50/30s and requires an airborne target. Vladimir's kit carries no projectile flag on any slot.
audit.corrected: Wind Wall now stated correctly as not blocking your kit; the knock-up condition, Last Breath's airborne requirement and 70s, Wind Wall's 25s/4s, and the minion-dash path written into the do's and don'ts.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing named the punishable window in numbers despite Wind Wall being the single biggest denial button in the lane.
audit.why: Wind Wall lasts 4s on a 25s rank-1 cooldown — 21 seconds of the lane where his only anti-poke tool is gone.
